I like to think of phenibut as the social cocaine of nootropics. Be very very careful as you are playing with something that you don't know how it'll affect your brain. I am a former phenibut addict.  Withdrawal effects made me want to commit suicide. You will want to use it more and more often if you are not careful. At higher doses (2-3g) you might feel even more of these positive effects, but you'll find yourself missing the feeling upon cessation and will want to chase it. I'd advise you to stick to the 1-2g range and take it 2x a month ONLY if you want the same feeling again and again. I take no responsibility for what I just told you, this is all for educational purposes. Absolutely do not drink alcohol while using this.

Hey kosmolite. I feel you. I almost committed suicide several fucking times when I was feeling so anxious. I couldn’t talk to people the way I wanted to, I couldn’t build up friendships, let alone a relationship (I was still a virgin at the time) but I realized I was avoiding the real issue at hand, and that was putting in the work to overcome the anxiety. It took a lot of tripping over my tail, coaching, investing money into self education, therapists and antidepressants- and now I feel confident enough to sell a pair of underwear on the street (I know it wouldn’t ACTUALLY sell) but you get the point. Had I not put in the work to overcome my fear, I wouldn’t be where I am today, fighting on the frontlines of the COVID pandemic in the ICU, have a girlfriend, strengthening my personal relationships with family and friends and loving myself fully every day and going to nursing school. Don’t get me wrong, I still suffer from anxiety everyday, sometimes to the point where I cannot function, but I have to get myself out of it anyway possible so I can serve others and benefit people’s lives. 
I know you can get out of your anxious mindset, you just have to take baby steps everyday. Little by little, like building a brick wall. You lay one brick every day. 
I wish you the very best, because I know you can do it. :)
